Impact The 24-year-old outfielder launched his first homer of the year in the sixth inning, ripping a Carter Baumler fastball over the fence in right field. Beavers has been used exclusively against right-handed pitching to begin the season, seeing action in all three outfield spots, and he's batting .286 (4-for-14) in that role with a double, a homer, three RBI and three runs. 1 HOUR AGO• ROTOWIRE Major League Baseball Last Night in Baseball: Yankees, Max Fried Match 83-Year-Old MLB Record 6 hours ago Major League Baseball MLB on FOX's Saturday Slate Preview: Yankees-Giants, Twins-Orioles, Royals-Braves 4 days ago 12 Major League Baseball MLB Spring Training Buzz: Orioles Extend Right-Hander Shane Baz 5 days ago 108 Major League Baseball FOX Sports Assembles Top-Tier Roster for 2026 MLB Regular Season Coverage 5 days ago 6 Major League Baseball 2026 MLB Odds: 4 Futures Wagers to Make During Opening Week 6 days ago 6 Major League Baseball Next Big Thing? View All Stories Samuel Basallo - Launches first homer of season Basallo went 2-for-5 with a solo home run in Wednesday's 8-3 win over the Rangers. Impact The 21-year-old slugger helped chase Nathan Eovaldi from the game when he led off the fourth inning by launching a fastball 437 feet over the wall in center field. It was Basallo's first homer and first RBI of the season in his fifth game, and he's batting .211 (4-for-19) in the early going with a 2:6 BB:K. 1 HOUR AGO• ROTOWIRE Trevor Rogers - Collects second win Rogers (2-0) picked up the win Wednesday. allowing two runs on six hits and a walk over six innings in an 8-3 victory over the Rangers. He struck out three. Impact Baltimore's offense jumped on Nathan Eovaldi early, and Rogers already had a 4-0 lead before Texas got to the southpaw for a couple runs in the fourth inning. Rogers has delivered back-to-back quality starts to begin the season, posting a 1.38 ERA, 1.08 WHIP and 8:5 K:BB through 13 innings. He'll look to extend his win streak in his next start, which lines up to come on the road early next week against the White Sox. 1 HOUR AGO• ROTOWIRE Orioles end game on ABS challenge for 1st time in MLB history, unfortunately for Rangers | Sporting News There's a first time for everything. 1 HOUR AGO• SPORTINGNEWS.COM We can say with certainty, no MLB game has ever ended like this before The first week of the first MLB season with the Automated Ball-Strike (ABS) Challenge System, powered by T-Mobile, has provided us with, wel... 2 HOURS AGO• MLB.COM Rogers outduels Eovaldi in Orioles' series-ending win over Rangers BALTIMORE -- If it felt like neither Orioles left-hander Trevor Rogers nor Rangers righty Nathan Eovaldi gave up many runs last year, that’s... 2 HOURS AGO• MLB.COM First game-ending robot umpire call gives Suárez first save in 9 years as O's top Rangers 8-3 The first game-ending call by a so-called robot umpire gave Albert Suárez his first major league save in nine years, ending the Baltimore Orioles’ 8-3 win over the Texas Rangers 2 HOURS AGO• Associated Press Last Night in Baseball: Yankees, Max Fried Match 83-Year-Old MLB Record The Yankees match history in their W, baseball physics are wild, Pete Alonso goes yard, what is C.B. Bucknor doing and more from Tuesday's M... 6 HOURS AGO• FOX SPORTS Tyler O'Neill - Taking seat for matinee game O'Neill is out of the lineup for Wednesday's game against the Rangers. Impact O'Neill had started in four of the Orioles' first five games but will hit the bench for the series finale as Baltimore goes with Taylor Ward at designated hitter and Colton Cowser in right field. Though Baltimore is at full strength in the outfield, O'Neill will be a regular presence in the lineup against left-handed pitching and should play at least semi-regularly against right-handers so long as he's swinging the bat reasonably well. 6 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Leody Taveras - Making first start of season Taveras will start in center field and bat eighth in Wednesday's game against the Rangers. Impact Taylor Ward will serve as the Orioles' designated hitter Wednesday, but his absence from the outfield will open up a spot for Tavares, who will make his first start of the season. The 27-year-old's playing time will likely remain sporadic throughout the 2026 campaign while the Orioles are at full strength in the outfield. 6 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Jeremiah Jackson - Making another start at keystone Jackson will start at second base and bat ninth in Wednesday's game against the Rangers. Impact Occupying second base for the fourth time in five games, Jackson appears to have the early edge in playing time at the position over Blaze Alexander. However, with just three hits and a 0:6 BB:K through 12 plate appearances, Jackson hasn't run away with the job. Both Jackson and Alexander will see their opportunities at the keystone dwindle once Jackson Holliday (hand) returns from the injured list, likely at some point around the middle of the month. 6 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Ryan Mountcastle - Seeing scarce playing time Mountcastle is out of the lineup for Wednesday's game against the Rangers. Impact Mountcastle has found playing time difficult to come by in the early going; he's started just once in the Orioles' first six games and has logged five plate appearances in total. With Samuel Basallo serving as the Orioles' primary designated hitter and offseason pickup Pete Alonso handling an everyday role at first base, Mountcastle likely won't have a path to steady at-bats unless either of the former two players misses time at some point. 6 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Adley Rutschman - Receiving rest Wednesday Rutschman is out of the lineup for Wednesday's game against the Rangers. Impact Samuel Basallo will handle the catching duties while Taylor Ward receives a start at designated hitter as Rutschman rests for the Wednesday matinee game. While starting in four of Baltimore's first six games, Rutschman has gone 4-for-14 with three doubles, three walks, one RBI and one run. 6 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Orioles rotation depth immediately tested by Zach Eflin injury The Zach Eflin injury put the Baltimore Orioles in a tough spot. They have Dean Kremer, but if their rotation sees any more injuries they do... 7 HOURS AGO• BIRDSWATCHER.COM Albert Suárez - Contract selected The Orioles selected Suarez's contract from Triple-A Norfolk on Wednesday. Impact Suarez joins the active roster as a replacement for Zach Eflin (elbow). The 36-year-old Suarez will provide some length out of the Orioles' bullpen. 8 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Jordan Westburg - Shifted to 60-day injured list The Orioles transferred Westburg (elbow) to the 60-day injured list Wednesday. Impact The transaction frees up a spot on the 40-man roster for the addition of Albert Suarez. Westburg is working his way back from a partially torn UCL in his right elbow and now will not be eligible to return until May 22. Coby Mayo will continue to fill in at third base for the Orioles while Westburg is sidelined. 8 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Zach Eflin - Sent to IL with sore elbow The Orioles placed Eflin (elbow) on the 15-day injured list Wednesday. Impact Eflin had to be lifted from Tuesday's start against the Rangers due to right elbow discomfort. He's set to undergo an MRI on Wednesday, at which point more will be known about how long he will be sidelined. Dean Kremer is likely to absorb Eflin's spot in the Baltimore rotation. 8 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Every AL team's fatal weakness ranked Every team has a weakness. Even teams that spend a lot of money and trade a lot of prospects can never fully rid themselves of flaws. The qu... 11 HOURS AGO• BIRDSWATCHER.COM Orioles play the Rangers after Ward's 4-hit game The Baltimore Orioles take on the Texas Rangers after Taylor Ward had four hits on Tuesday in an 8-5 loss to the Rangers 14 HOURS AGO• Associated Press Taylor Ward - Four-hit effort in loss Ward went 4-for-5 with two RBI and a run scored during Tuesday's 8-5 loss to the Rangers. Impact Tuesday marks the first time that Ward has logged four hits in a game, and his impressive display of hitting puts him at a .300 batting average (6-for-20) through the first five games of the season. He's unlikely to continue at that pace after batting just .228 last year, but he should be able to make up for it once he rediscovers his power stroke. 16 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Yennier Cano - Charged with loss Tuesday Cano (0-1) took the loss Tuesday versus the Rangers, allowing one run on two hits and no walks in the sixth inning. Impact Cano had given the Orioles a pair of scoreless outing during the club's opening series against the Twins, but he gave up his first run of the season Tuesday. The right-hander pitched fairly well during the spring to make Baltimore's Opening Day bullpen, posting a 3.86 ERA, 1.00 WHIP and 6:0 K:BB over seven Grapefruit League innings, but Cano could fall into a middle-relief role once Andrew Kittredge (shoulder) and Keegan Akin (groin) are ready to return. 18 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Albert Suárez - En route to Baltimore The Orioles are expected to recall Suarez from Triple-A Norfolk on Wednesday, Andy Kostka of TheBaltimoreBanner.com reports. Impact With Zach Eflin (elbow) likely headed for the injured list, Suarez will come up from the minors to provide extra bullpen depth until the team needs to fill the open rotation spot. The 36-year-old righty made five appearances in the majors last season and allowed just three earned runs over 11.2 innings, but he turned in a 7.59 ERA and 1.97 WHIP across 10.2 frames in the Grapefruit League this spring. 19 HOURS AGO• ROTOWIRE Zach Eflin - Expected to land on IL Manager Craig Albernaz said after Tuesday's loss to the Rangers that he expects Eflin (elbow) to be placed on the injured list, Andy Kostka of TheBaltimoreBanner.com reports. Impact Eflin made an early exit from Tuesday's contest after 3.2 innings of one-run ball due to elbow discomfort. He's scheduled to receive an MRI on his elbow Wednesday, but the Orioles don't seem to be very optimistic about what the results will show.
